task.question: Who was dismissed as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine on 21 July 2026?
task.evidence: 21 July – President Zelenskyy dismisses Oleksandr Syrskyi as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, replacing him with Mykhailo Drapatyi amidst protests demanding Syrskyi’s removal.

answer:
On July 21, 2026, President Volodymyr Zelensky dismissed General Oleksandr Syrskyi as the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. He was replaced by General Mykhailo Drapatyi, who was previously the Commander of the Joint Forces. This change followed widespread protests related to recent political decisions in the country. 

FINAL: Oleksandr Syrskyi was dismissed.
